correctness.rationale: Dhar burning produces necessary and sufficient 3-letter states on each cut triangle, exactly 3^k. The explicit positive integer odometer U satisfies LU=e_penultimate+e_tip+e_final-spoke, and all-A after tip addition maps to the recurrent word ending C,B; uniqueness makes it the odometer. Monotonicity makes it an upper bound for every recurrent state. U can be actual odometer exactly when last two codes are A,A; other terminal words yield negative/nonrecurrent post-U state. Therefore maximum=2k²+k−1 with 3^(k−2) maximizers. Stationary expectation solves L E[u]=e_tip, giving (2k²+k)/3. Independent standalone exact checks replayed; finite tests are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The model is a canonical sequence of triangular frustrated cells with graph degree at most four, linking finite dissipative sandpile wave propagation to sequential articulation barriers. It gives a complete all-size sharp toppling upper bound and an exact nonvanishing atom of order-k² events, determined surprisingly by just the last two microscopic blocks; the probability and exact mean offer checkable benchmarks for multiwave avalanche theories. Beyond correctness or novelty, this directly addresses the motivated question of whether severe nonlocal toppling at finite chain ends is typical or exponentially unlikely.
